verdict.rationale: Gusto Embedded documents a 401(k) offering through its Guideline partnership: partners can give employer payroll admins a pre-built flow link to access Guideline, and the platform overview lists 401(k) (Guideline) among its benefits. Payrolls also carry contributions, since off-cycle runs reuse the regular contribution settings. The evidence never states that Guideline 401(k) contributions sync automatically with each payroll run, and the setup goes through a third-party provider via a link-out flow. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic per-payroll 401(k) contribution sync, details of the Guideline data exchange or contribution APIs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
